svg.font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
svg.title: How an update ends
svg.desc: The updater checks the signatures and downloads the images. A failure there ends Not installed and changes nothing. It then switches the containers, and the new gateway migrates the databases. If it comes back online, the update ends Updated. If it fails, the updater starts the previous version again and ends Rolled back, or Rollback failed when that doesn't start. When the new gateway may already have migrated the databases, the update ends Needs attention instead.
